levels.surface: أبا غسان، محمد بن عمرو الرازي

notes: «قال مسلم» is the compiler himself (rule 13): not written. «سمعت أبا غسان» makes Abu Ghassan the first link.
«سألت جرير بن عبد الحميد»: the asker (Abu Ghassan) is a link and the asked (Jarir) answers, whose words are the saying (rule 5). Harith b. Husayra is the subject of the question, not a link.
